representative_text: For a patient with a recurrent tumor at the gastroesophageal junction, please plan an endoluminal brachytherapy boost. Using a single-channel applicator with 8 dwell positions, prescribe 5 Gy per fraction in 3 fractions. The dose should be prescribed at 1cm from the source axis. Optimize to cover the tumor while sparing the heart and lungs.
